correctness.rationale: Two-stage endpoint decomposition and globally monotone Bellman potentials give exact values for all finite paths and all adaptive policies. Reflected drift corrections are tight by geometric return bounds; the stopped-martingale CLT and strong Markov independence yield Gaussian variance 4pq(1+eta)/delta^3. The included exact checker passed 3600 Bellman checks and independently derived second-moment convergence; finite tests support rather than prove the limiting law.

value.rationale: The natural path test case of a studied choice-random-walk model receives exact all-start optimal values, explicit quadratic-to-linear crossover with one extra choice, parity-sensitive boundary terms, and a sharp distributional performance law. This closes quantitative questions not settled by general tree O(n) coverage, rather than reprinting a textbook hitting-time exercise.
